pc_screen_capture.notes: Preferred serious live feed. User keeps chart visible on their PC and the lightweight agent posts frames to the cloud brain.

mobile_manual_upload.notes: Manual screenshot/camera/file upload from phone or browser. Good for testing, not ideal for unattended live tracking.

mobile_pwa_screen_capture.notes: Works only where the browser supports display capture. Use native apps for dependable continuous mobile capture.

android_native_capture.notes: Future Android app should use MediaProjection and post to the same frame-ingest endpoint.

ios_replaykit_capture.notes: Future iOS app should use ReplayKit/Broadcast Upload and post to the same frame-ingest endpoint.

browser_extension_capture.notes: Future browser extension can capture chart tab content without requiring full desktop screenshots.

mt4_chart_screenshot.notes: Future MT4/MT5 chart capture adapter can post screenshots and metadata into the universal contract.
